name: analyze-project
description: Auto-detect the host project stack (frontend, backend, DB, auth, routes). Trigger: /AIQA-AnalyzeProject or analyze project or detect project or what stack

name: analyze-story
description: Parse a user story and extract acceptance criteria, scenarios, risks, and edge cases. Trigger: /AIQA-AnalyzeStory <story-file> or analyze story or parse story or extract AC

name: full-workflow
description: Run all 7 QA phases end-to-end for a story. Trigger: /AIQA-FullWorkflow <story-file> or full workflow or run all or test this story

name: generate-e2e
description: Generate Playwright E2E test files (Page Object + spec). Trigger: /AIQA-GenerateE2E <story-file> or generate e2e or write playwright tests or create test files

name: generate-report
description: Generate final QA summary report in HTML, MD, and XLSX. Trigger: /AIQA-GenerateReport or generate report or create report or show results

name: regression-test
description: Re-run the baseline test suite and compare with previous run. Trigger: /AIQA-RegressionTest or regression test or re-run tests or diff tests

name: security-scan
description: Run OWASP-style security validation on detected endpoints. Trigger: /AIQA-SecurityScan or security scan or security check or OWASP

name: accessibility-scan
description: Run a11y audit on detected pages. Trigger: /AIQA-AccessibilityScan or accessibility scan or a11y check or check accessibility

name: autonomous-run
description: Run autonomous QA loop that plans, acts, observes, and reflects. Trigger: /AIQA-AutoRun or autonomous run or auto test or run loop

name: reset-framework
description: Wipe all test outputs from TestResult/ and reset QA history log. Trigger: /AIQA-Reset or reset framework or clear results or fresh cycle
